'''Reflections: A Collector's Bounty''' (sold as '''Reflections''') is the 23rd Star Wars CCG product, published by Decipher in January 2000. It is 114 foil cards (57 per side): 87 very rare foils, 25 super rare foils, and 2 ultra rare foils ([[Darth Vader]] and [[Luke Skywalker]]). Displays shipped with oversized, non-playable objective box toppers.

Packs are 18 cards, MSRP $4.95, 30 packs per box. Each pack has '''one foil''' from the list below plus random reprints from earlier expansions. Those reprints are not listed here. A foil of a title not on this list is not a Reflections pack foil. It may be a later [[Promotional Foils|promotional foil]], a Japanese foil, or a counterfeit.<ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2]. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].</ref>

== Box toppers ==
Each display included one of two '''oversized''' (about 5&Prime; &times; 7&Prime;) objective cards. They are promotional / non-playable and are '''not''' part of the 114 pack foils:<ref name="encyc" />

* [[Mind What You Have Learned / Save You It Can]]
* [[Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi / Their Fire Has Gone Out Of The Universe]]

[[File:Reflections-box-toppers.png|640px|Reflections oversized box toppers]]

== Print sheets ==
Foils are 10&times;10 (100 cards). Each side had two foil sheets. Ultra rare foil once on one of the two sheets; super rare foil 2&times; across both; very rare foil 4&times; across both.<ref name="encyc" />
